title: Cohomology with support
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], meaning a locally ringed space
locally isomorphic to spectra of commutative rings, and let
$i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with open complement
$j:U\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-open-immersion], and let $F$ be a torsion abelian sheaf
[def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf] on the small etale site of $X$
[def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. For any abelian sheaf $G$ on this site
[def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], define
its group of sections with support in $Z$ by

$$
 \Gamma_Z(X,G)=\ker\bigl(G(X)\xrightarrow{\mathrm{res}_{X,U}}G(U)\bigr).
$$

The arrow is restriction along $j$; a morphism $G\to G'$ acts by its
map on sections over $X$, restricted to these kernels. Thus
$\Gamma_Z(X,-):\textit{Ab}(X_{\mathrm{et}})\to\textit{Ab}$ is a
functor to abelian groups. For $q\geq0$,
write $H^q_Z(X,F)=R^q\Gamma_Z(X,-)(F)$ for the right derived functors
[def-sp-left-exact-additive], computed from an injective resolution
[def-sp-injective-resolutions] in the category of abelian sheaves, which has enough injectives
[lem-weil-pbc-site-sheaves-enough-injectives]:

$$
 H^q_Z(X,F)=H^q\bigl(\Gamma_Z(X,I^\bullet)\bigr)
 \qquad(F\longrightarrow I^\bullet).
$$

For a bounded-below complex $K$ with torsion cohomology in the derived
categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the same notation means
$H^q_Z(X,K)=H^q(R\Gamma_Z(X,K))$, where $R\Gamma_Z$ is the bounded-below
right derived functor of the displayed functor
[lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-plus-injective]; here $q$ may be any integer.
On the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] with finite-torsion
coefficients in the conventions of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed],
use the identical kernel-of-restriction construction and its right
derived functor in that topology. Cohomology of complexes is taken in
the corresponding derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].
